((report_slot != '' AND (repo_id, run_id, report_slot, run_attempt) IN (SELECT repo_id, run_id, report_slot, max(run_attempt) FROM test_suite_results FINAL WHERE org_id = {org_id:String} AND report_slot != '' GROUP BY repo_id, run_id, report_slot)) OR (report_slot = '' AND (repo_id, run_id, suite_id) NOT IN (SELECT repo_id, run_id, arrayJoin(legacy_suite_ids) FROM test_suite_results FINAL WHERE org_id = {org_id:String} AND report_slot != '' AND (repo_id, run_id, report_slot, run_attempt) IN (SELECT repo_id, run_id, report_slot, max(run_attempt) FROM test_suite_results FINAL WHERE org_id = {org_id:String} AND report_slot != '' GROUP BY repo_id, run_id, report_slot))))
